method: Full pinned template read; Git/SHA256 verified. Extracted original equality-check functions, normalized printf template escapes and ran only original_check on temporary files through /bin/sh. No modification handlers or full generated script executed.
findings: Default original_check checks existence and literal path-string inequality, allowing hardlinks. Size/content comparison requires explicit paranoid flag. Control accepts files differing in size and bytes with paranoid disabled and rejects them with enabled cmp.

Paranoid regular-file check calls cmp -s -- with quoted arguments; directory path delegates to configured rmlint -p --equal plus generated options. No fd-bound check prevents replacement between comparison and later action.

Symlink/hardlink replacement moves duplicate to fixed path suffix .temp, attempts link and restores on failure. Existing suffix conflicts and concurrent changes are not independently resolved in template.

Reflink copy uses GNU archive/reflink options and saves/restores mtime via temporary stamps. Clone handler delegates validation to --dedupe. These modes have different correctness dependencies; none executed here.

Error handling uses set -eu by default and optional set +e, EXIT cleanup and individual swallowed strip/chown failures. INT/TERM trap marks clean exit; exact signal-derived status remains unqualified. A final message alone cannot prove every operation succeeded.

Cleanup can walk upward removing empty parent directories when enabled, without explicit scan-root bound in this template. Empty-file/broken-link handlers do not revalidate type/emptiness. No such operations executed.

executed_control.scope: Only extracted predicate functions; no deletion/link/copy/ownership handlers.
